description: This file defines the ThemePreprocess class for Drupal, containing methods to preprocess variables for various theme templates such as container, links, html, page, maintenance, region, table, item list, and maintenance task list. It handles theme-specific variable preparation, attribute management, and includes external dependencies related to rendering, routing, and utility functions.

classes.name: ThemePreprocess
classes.description: A class providing preprocessing methods for Drupal theme templates, including container, links, html, page, maintenance, region, table, item list, and maintenance task list.

methods.name: preprocessContainer
methods.description: Prepares variables for container templates, setting 'has_parent', 'children', and 'attributes'.

methods.name: preprocessLinks
methods.description: Prepares variables for links templates, handling active classes, attributes, and link generation.

methods.name: preprocessHtml
methods.description: Prepares variables for HTML document templates, including page, title, and language attributes.

methods.name: preprocessPage
methods.description: Prepares variables for page templates, setting regions, paths, and node parameters.

methods.name: preprocessMaintenancePage
methods.description: Prepares variables for maintenance page templates, including branding and assets.

methods.name: preprocessInstallPage
methods.description: Prepares variables for install page templates, overriding site name and version during installation.

methods.name: preprocessRegion
methods.description: Prepares variables for region templates, setting content and region name.

methods.name: preprocessTable
methods.description: Prepares variables for table templates, formatting headers, rows, colgroups, and responsiveness.

methods.name: preprocessTablesortIndicator
methods.description: Prepares variables for tablesort indicator templates, attaching the tablesort library.

methods.name: preprocessItemList
methods.description: Prepares variables for item list templates, handling nested list inheritance and attributes.

methods.name: preprocessMaintenanceTaskList
methods.description: Prepares variables for maintenance task list templates, marking active and completed tasks.
